text: dsh-github-picker 是 DSH Web 的 GitHub issue 与 PR 选择器，可从输入框搜索当前工作区仓库，按关键词或开放状态筛选并翻页。选中条目后可插入仓库引用或 GitHub URL；发送前 Host 会识别引用并附上仓库和编号。插件设置页显示 gh 登录状态。适合需要在 DSH 对话中引用仓库工单的开发者，需安装并登录本机 gh CLI。

dsh-github-picker adds a GitHub issue and PR picker to DSH Web. Search the workspace repository, filter by keyword or status, and browse results. Selecting an item inserts a repository reference or URL; the Host recognizes references before an agent step. Requires the local gh CLI and login.
想在 DSH Web 对话里快速插入 GitHub issue 或 PR 编号
能不能从当前代码仓库直接查找相关的 GitHub 工单？
让 DSH 输入框提供一个可搜索 issue 和 pull request 的选择器
我希望按标题或编号筛选本仓库的 GitHub 问题
想区分开放和已关闭的 issue，再选一条放进草稿
DSH 能否把选择的工单链接插入当前消息？
需要让 agent 发送前识别消息中的 GitHub 编号引用
How can I search this workspace repository’s issues from the DSH composer?
dsh-github-picker 的功能「GitHub 工单搜索」：在 DSH Web 输入框打开选择器，按关键词及开放状态搜索当前工作区仓库的 issue 和 PR，并分页显示结果。
dsh-github-picker 的功能「插入工单引用」：选择搜索结果后，将 @owner/repo#编号或 GitHub URL 按设置写入对话草稿。
dsh-github-picker 的功能「发送前标记引用」：agent 每步开始前扫描消息中的 GitHub URL、仓库编号引用和裸 #编号，并为识别到的引用附加仓库及编号。
dsh-github-picker 的功能「查看 gh 登录状态」：插件设置卡调用 Host 查询 gh CLI 已登录账户状态，并显示连接状态及插入格式选项。
dsh-github-picker 使用前须知：搜索通过本机 gh CLI 请求 GitHub 的 search/issues 接口，需先在本机登录 gh；插件只传回仓库与编号作为引用标记。

dsh-github-picker README · dsh-github-picker：
English | [中文](README.zh.md)
GitHub issue and pull request references for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click the GitHub icon next to the send button to search the current workspace repository's issues and PRs, and insert a reference — a GitHub URL or an `@owner/repo#number` mention.

dsh-github-picker README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-github-picker
```

The same command updates an existing installation to the latest published version; append `@<version>` to pin one. Restart `dsh web` after installing.

dsh-github-picker README · Usage：Click the GitHub icon in the composer's tool row. The popup lists the repository's recent issues and PRs — 12 per page, loading the next page as you scroll to the bottom, no result cap — with an open/closed filter applied to the search itself (every page contains matching entries only) and a local text filter by number or title (a number prefix ranks first). Click a row to insert the reference; Escape or a click outside closes the popup. A search failure (gh CLI missing, not authenticated, rate limited, network error, unresolved repository) renders as one localized hint row instead of a silent close.

dsh-github-picker README · Usage：On a phone the popup fits itself to the visible viewport (keyboard included) instead of being clipped, rows are taller with the open-in-browser button always visible, and the search field is 16px so iOS does not zoom the page in.

Each row shows GitHub's state icon, the title, and the `#number` tag:

dsh-github-picker README · Usage：| State | Icon |
| --- | --- |
| Open issue | `issue-opened` (green) |
| Closed issue | `issue-closed` (purple) |
| Open PR | `git-pull-request` (green) |
| Draft PR | `git-pull-request-draft` (gray) |
| Closed, unmerged PR | `git-pull-request-closed` (red) |
| Merged PR | `git-merge` (purple) |

Picking inserts the text chosen as **insert format** in Settings:

```text
@owner/name#125                                 # ref (default)
https://github.com/owner/name/issues/125        # url
```

dsh-github-picker README · Usage：Before each step, the Host scans the draft for GitHub references — URLs, `@owner/repo#number`, and bare `#number` — and adds a short message per match:

```xml
<github-reference repo="owner/name" number="125" />
```

Only the repository and number are passed; issue bodies are never fetched.

dsh-github-picker README · Data Source：The **gh CLI** only: it reuses the local `gh` login and calls `gh api search/issues` (issues and PRs in one query). No device flow, OAuth app, or stored credential. The repository is resolved from the workspace's `git remote get-url origin` (https, ssh, `git@` forms); without a resolvable remote, the popup shows a hint row on adding one.

dsh-github-picker README · Settings：The plugin card — titled "GitHub 引用" (or "GitHub Picker" in English) — lives in the official configurable-plugins tab. It shows the gh connection status (which accounts `gh auth status` reports) and the **insert format** (`@owner/repo#number` or `GitHub URL`). That is the only setting: there is no enable switch — the picker is always on — and no result limit.

dsh-github-picker README · Configuration：Host options go into the selected profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-github-picker
  config:
    searchTimeoutMs: 15000
    repoCacheTtl: 30000

- `searchTimeoutMs` bounds provider calls (default 15000).
- `repoCacheTtl` caches the resolved repository per workspace (default 30000 ms).

A Host config change needs a `dsh web` restart; a client-only change just needs a browser refresh.

dsh-github-picker README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
```

The check ladder is typecheck + tests + build with 100% coverage per source file; `lib/` is committed, so profile installs run without a build. For a local checkout, add the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` (dependency + `dsh.profile.bundles`), `pnpm install`, restart `dsh web`. The plugin serves at `/plugins/dsh-github-picker/client.js`, the gateway routes `/api/githubPicker/*`.
